summary: Make connected folded planes the defining expression and distinguish an inspired sculpture from a verified foldable design.
objective: The intended fold rhythm is visible without relying on texture lines alone; any unverified sheet construction is disclosed.
intent_signals: Emphasize connected folded planes and creases
example_prompts: Design an origami-inspired bird sculpture and label its folding motion as illustrative unless verified.

principles: Make connected folded planes the defining expression and distinguish an inspired sculpture from a verified foldable design.
implementation: Arrange a continuous-looking sequence of planes and creases; keep seams explicit where the imagined object uses separate pieces.
Use restrained surface color and directional light to expose crease valleys and ridges.
Choose views that reveal plane continuity; folding animation needs a separate geometric contract before claiming the object can be folded from a sheet.

Model creases as real geometry with 0.15-0.2 mm rounded ridges and mountain/valley angles between 30 and 150 degrees, keeping the sheet one connected surface unless a separate piece is deliberately disclosed.
Use a two-sided sheet material (#e8563f outside, #f6f1e6 inside) so a valley fold reveals the second colour, and hold the key at 30 degrees so every plane lands on a four-step value ramp.
observable_checks: The intended fold rhythm is visible without relying on texture lines alone; any unverified sheet construction is disclosed.

known_limits: Values are authored starting points tuned for ACESFilmic tone mapping at renderer.toneMappingExposure 1.0; re-tune intensities and fog density under a different tone mapping or exposure.
No renderer run for this record; values are authored starting points.
creative_affordances: Combine with monochrome or faceted treatment; preserve the difference between an angular look and a validated origami mechanism.

defaults.rationale: With no texture and one hue, the only descriptive signals are plane orientation and the reverse side of the sheet, so the ratio is opened to 5:1 at a low 30 degree key to force a clear value step across each crease. A double-sided material with a 0.15 mm bevel makes every fold announce itself twice - once as a value change and once as a colour flip - which is what keeps the form readable without crease-line textures.

values.value_structure: 20/55/25 dark/mid/light; every value step comes from plane orientation alone
values.saturation_rule: one saturated sheet hue up to 75%; everything else under 20%

lights.ratio: key:fill ~ 5:1 so adjacent planes differ by at least one clear step

values.intensity_unit: three-intensity (lux-scaled for Directional/Hemisphere, candela for Point/Spot; tuned with the stated tone_mapping.exposure)

materials.notes: double-sided material with backface rendering on; 0.8 outside, 0.9 inside; 0.15 mm crease bevel so each ridge catches a 1 px highlight

values.signature_technique: two-sided sheet colour under a 30 degree key, so every fold is announced by a value step and a colour flip at the same edge
never: crease lines painted as texture instead of modelled
implying a verified foldable crease pattern
single-sided material that shows black backfaces
